text:
NOTE
**Still not ready — screenshots and description improved, but commits need cleanup**

New: The author pushed two more commits, raised the width cap to 15em, redid the before/after screenshots with a long name, and added a comparison with the other open PRs. Missing: the fix commits are not squashed into the main commit, and the diff (+59/-29) is much bigger than the described CSS change, including an unrelated font-weight animation edit.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and don't assign a reviewer; the author can re-request review once the commits are cleaned up.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for updating the screenshots and explaining how this relates to the other PRs! Please squash the "fix:" and "css(reactions):" commits into the main commit, and drop the unrelated font-weight and formatting changes so the diff only contains the truncation fix (see the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html)).
```
